mechanism.claim: In an already elevated BVOL-and-DVOL regime, a fixed eight-hour BTC move whose first and second four-hour returns agree and whose total displacement and close-path efficiency are both unusually high represents persistent price discovery rather than a transient shock; the direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: sign of the completed eight-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDPR is a persistent-trend state: same-direction block halves plus high total displacement and high path efficiency. It is not HVCRR's inefficient chop/range escape, CVVIB's volatility ignition, intrahour absorption, funding direction, or a control promotion.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: signals occur only at fixed eight-hour boundaries and require dual implied-volatility levels plus multi-hour directional persistence absent from Gross9

clock.decision: exact UTC 00:00/08:00/16:00 boundary D after eight consecutive completed valid hours [D-8h,D)
clock.volatile_regime: BVOL close and DVOL close at D each >= own strict-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.directional_persistence: nonzero first-four-hour and second-four-hour BTC returns have the same sign
clock.large_move: absolute eight-hour return >= strict-prior 270-block q60 with 252 observations
clock.path_efficiency: absolute eight-hour return divided by sum of eight absolute hourly returns >= strict-prior 270-block q60 with 252 observations; zero denominator invalid
clock.reservation: fixed blocks are nonoverlapping; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR
